name: Dell XPS 13 (9315)
excerpt: Two Thunderbolt 4 (USB4) USB Type-C ports with Power Delivery and DisplayPort. Supports up to two 4K displays or one 5K display at 60Hz. Minimum and maximum USB-C Power Delivery input is 45 W.

evidence_excerpts.operating_system: Operating systems supported: Windows 11 Home, Windows 11 Pro.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_port_count: Two Thunderbolt 4 (USB4) USB Type-C ports with Power Delivery and DisplayPort.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_data_rate_gbps: Supports USB4 Gen 3x2 with data transfer rates up to 40 Gbps.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_video_supported: Supports DisplayPort 1.4 output through USB Type-C.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_pd_input_min_w: Power Delivery input: 45 W USB Type-C AC adapter.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_pd_input_max_w: Input power rating: 45 W (20 V / 2.25 A).
evidence_excerpts.maximum_external_displays: Supports connecting up to two external 4K displays.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_max_resolution: Supports up to 5120 x 2880 at 60 Hz on an external 5K display.
evidence_excerpts.usb_c_max_refresh_hz: Supports refresh rate of 60 Hz at maximum external resolution.
evidence_excerpts.display_configurations: Supports simultaneous connection of up to two external 4K displays at 60 Hz or two 1080p displays in extended mode over Thunderbolt.
